response.overview: FROM THE TWISTED IMAGINATION OF DAN PEACH, A BRAND-NEW BRITISH HORROR ANTHOLOGY IS BORN. SATAN'S CELLAR FOLLOWS A LOCAL HEAVY METAL BAND, HALF-EATEN ANGELS, WHO TURN TO THE ANCIENT GODDESS ROBONGULA, TO HELP THEM TO WIN A BATTLE OF THE BANDS COMPETITION. UNBEKNOWNST TO THE BAND, THEIR INNOCENT CAMPFIRE HORROR STORIES UNLEASH A MYRIAD OF MONSTERS AND VILLAINS, CROSSING THAT EVER FATAL LINE BETWEEN REALITY AND THE SUPERNATURAL WORLDS. GORE, CHAOS AND DARK BRITISH HUMOUR THROUGHOUT.  SATAN'S CELLAR ASKS THE ETERNAL QUESTION... "HOW FAR WOULD YOU BE WILLING TO GO TO MAKE YOUR TBAND SUCCESSFUL?"  KILLER SOUNDTRACK BY LESBIAN BED DEATH
response.tagline: BEHIND EVERY DOOR, A NIGHTMARE AWAITS
response.title: Satan's Cellar
